title: No heat with an elderly parent: priority
instructions: You are Marcus Thistlewood. Your heat stopped completely last night and your 82-year-old father lives with you. It's cold inside but you don't know the exact temperature. No gas smell, no alarms. Your home is 88 Rockrose Ave, Staten Island 10314 (spell Rockrose if asked: R O C K R O S E). Your phone is 718 555 0103. The boiler is a Burnham, maybe 15 years old. You already checked that the thermostat is set to heat at 70.
